contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VAL [---]AVG ; R/ SECVRIT[AS REI PVBLICAE]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Lyons mint Victory left issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VAL [---]AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: SECVRIT[AS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: LVG. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 2.10gms, die axis: 12
